question: Should ClickClack permanently expose separate persisted alignment preferences for the current user's messages and all other human or agent messages?
rationale: The patch demonstrates a workable implementation, but repository evidence does not establish whether adding this second preference is desired long-term product and settings surface.

options.title: Approve independent alignment
options.body: Accept the two-setting model and merge once maintainers are satisfied with the remaining required-check state.

options.title: Keep one alignment setting
options.body: Decline the additional preference and retain the current user-only alignment model on main.

options.title: Narrow the UX model
options.body: Ask for a revised interaction such as predefined conversation-layout choices rather than two independent selectors.

recommendation.title: Approve independent alignment
recommendation.body: Accept the two-setting model and merge once maintainers are satisfied with the remaining required-check state.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product-routing candidate for ClickClack, while the supplied feature history does not identify a narrower owner.
